programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Porsche 911 GT3 RS
programme.desc: Alex hat sein Messgerät eingepackt und testet den Porsche 911 GT3 RS. Fünf Wow-Fakten zu einem unglaublichen Auto, das mehr Rennwagen als Straßen-Fahrzeug ist.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Auto-Klimaanlage
programme.desc: Heutzutage hat eigentlich jedes moderne Auto eine Klimaanlage an Bord. Da sich die "Klima" aber nicht nur um eine angenehme Temperatur kümmert, sondern auch die Luftfeuchtigkeit regelt, heißt es: Ekel-Alarm! Bakterien, gesundheitsschädliche Keime, ekelhafte Gerüche: Alex verrät euch, welche Todsünden ihr im Umgang mit der Auto-Klimaanlage nicht begehen solltet!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Autos aus China
programme.desc: Noch vor wenigen Jahren wurden Autohersteller aus China hierzulande belächelt und kaum ernstgenommen. Das hat sich stark geändert! Wo die Chinesen aufgeholt haben und wo sie uns schon heute meilenweit voraus sind, erklärt euch Alex im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Formel E
programme.desc: Die Formel E startet 2023 mit einer neuen Auto-Generation: Mehr Geschwindigkeit, mehr Rekuperation und Express-Ladestopps sollen für Spannung und Adrenalin sorgen. Reicht das? Alexander Bloch ist beim Formel E Grand Prix in Mexiko und erklärt die Irrtümer der letzten Formel E Generation. Was hat sich getan? Kommen Motorsport-Fans jetzt auf ihre Kosten?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Offroad-Todsünden
programme.desc: Offroad fahren ist eine Wissenschaft für sich. Alex zeigt euch 10 Todsünde, die ihr nicht machen dürft. So kommt ihr dann sicher durchs Gelände.

programme.title: Die 7
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Renault Megane etech
programme.desc: Alex nimmt den Renault Megane E-Tech 220 im Supertest unter die Lupe: Während er bei der Innenraum-Qualität Pluspunkte sammeln kann, gibt es an anderer Stelle Verbesserungspotenzial.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - VW ID.Buzz
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch prüft den Volkswagen ID.Buzz auf Herz und Nieren. Was hat der Bus auf MEB-Basis zu bieten?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - VW ID.4 GTX
programme.desc: VW schickt den ID.4 zum renovierten und verschärften Elektro-Auto-Supertest mit Alexander Bloch. Kann der Wolfsburger überzeugen? Er bringt einige große Stärken mit zum Test, offenbart aber auch ärgerliche Schwächen im Detail.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - BMW i5: Deutschland kann es doch!
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch bittet den BMW i5 eDrive40 zu einem ersten Check. Im ersten rein elektrischen 5er BMW sorgt der gleiche Elektromotor wie im BMW i4 eDrive40 für Vortrieb. Nun hat die E-Maschine mit mehr Gewicht zu kämpfen. Wie sich das auf die Reichweite und den Verbrauch auswirkt, ermittelt Bloch vor laufender Kamera. Dank Hands-Free-Driving geht das auch ohne Hände am Steuer.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Autonomes Fahren - Blick in die Zukunft mit autoELF
programme.desc: Die autoELF entstand im Projekt UNICARagil - ein autonomes Fahrzeug gemäß Level 4. Um autonom fahren zu können, braucht es viele verschiedene Sensoren - und die sind teuer. Alex Bloch lässt sich mit verschiedenen Manövern über die Teststrecke chauffieren und bespricht im Interview mit Prof. Dr.-Ing. Steven Peters die autonome Zukunft.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Die 5 Todsünden auf den ersten 1.000 km
programme.desc: Man hat lange gewartet und endlich ist es soweit: der Neuwagen ist da! Am liebsten würde man jetzt sofort ordentlich Gas geben. Aber Moment mal, war da nicht irgendwas? So ein neues Auto muss doch erst eingefahren werden, oder? Alexander Bloch erklärt, was auf den ersten 1.000 Kilometern zu beachten ist: Motor, Turbo, Bremsen, Dämpfer, Reifen - es gibt eine Menge zu tun.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Auto-Highlights 2024: Auch ohne Förderung ein gutes Jahr
programme.desc: Auch 2024 kürt Alex Bloch wieder seine E-Auto-Highlights. Hier seht ihr die Top-Neuheiten: Günstig, schnell, viel Platz oder Offroad-tauglich. Hier ist für jeden etwas dabei!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Straße weiß, Akku leer? 4 E-Auto Winter-Mythen
programme.desc: Wenn es draußen frostig und kalt ist, kommt man mit dem E-Auto nur noch halb soweit und auch das Aufladen dauert doppelt so lang. Ist das wirklich so? Eisbär Alexander Bloch räumt mit den 4 gängigsten Winter-Mythen zu E-Autos auf.

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Doppelkupplungsgetriebe
programme.desc: Das Doppelkupplungsgetriebe hat in vielen Modellen die klassische Wandler-Automatik abgelöst. Größter Vorteil: nahezu keine Zugkraftunterbrechung. Doch die Technik ist nicht unumstritten - gerade in Bezug auf Komfort und Haltbarkeit. Alexander Bloch erklärt die 6 größten Irrtümer zum Doppelkupplungsgetriebe.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Motor-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Egal ob Benziner, Diesel oder Elektro: Ohne Motor geht nichts. Dabei gibt es rund um die Motorentechnik viele Stammtischweisheiten: z.B. Hubraum ist durch nichts zu ersetzen. Aber ist das wirklich so? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 10 größten Irrtümer zu Downsizing, Turbo und Co.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Starter-Batterie
programme.desc: Es ist faszinierend: wir fahren mit modernsten Autos durch die Gegend, diskutieren über Lithium-Ionen-Akkus und trotzdem würde ohne eine jahrhundertealte Stromspeicher-Technologie quasi der komplette Autoverkehr stillstehen: Der Bleiakkumulator. Alt genug, damit sich eine Menge Irrtümer bilden konnten. Wir klären heute die 8 größten Irrtümer zur Starterbatterie und geben Tipps zum Tausch und zur Starthilfe.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Energie-Verschwendung: So machst DU es richtig!
programme.desc: Während ganz Deutschland über Nachhaltigkeit, Energiewende und Effizienz von Autos diskutiert, drehen wir den Spieß um: Alexander Bloch hat die Gebote des Mehrverbrauchs. So verschwendest du am besten Energie!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Komatsu PC4000
programme.desc: Der Komatsu PC4000 bringt einige Superlative mit sich. Das Riesengerät wird nicht nur in Deutschland gebaut, sondern auch bewegt. In einem Steinbruch bei Düsseldorf verrichtet dieser Brecher sein Werk und Alexander Bloch darf ihn erklären.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Renault Scenic E-Tech: Überzeugend, aber da wäre noch mehr drin gewesen!
programme.desc: Der Renault Scenic hat sich vom Verbrenner-Van zum Elektro-SUV gewandelt. Pluspunkte gibt‘s für den modernen Innenraum, das großzügige Platzangebot und das auf Komfort ausgelegte Fahrwerk. Wie der Familien-Stromer auf ganzer Linie abschneidet, seht ihr jetzt im E-Auto-Supertest mit Alex Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Honda e:Ny1 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Nach hübsch und unpraktisch, jetzt normal und praktisch? Der Honda e war der erste Versuch der Japaner mit einem vollelektrischen Fahrzeug. Der Neue mit dem unaussprechlichen Namen e:Ny1 basiert auf der von Honda neu entwickelten Frontantriebsplattform e:N Architecture F, die weltweit in Elektrofahrzeugen im B-Segment zum Einsatz kommen wird. Wie schlägt sich das kompakte SUV im E-Auto Supertest?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Kia EV9 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der Kia EV9 ist der „King Kong“ unter den SUVs – ein imposanter Koloss, den manche als überdimensioniert und unnötig empfinden. Alexander Bloch räumt mit diesen Vorurteilen auf und stellt den EV9 im direkten Vergleich zum beliebten VW ID.Buzz unter Beweis.

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Porsche Taycan im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Porsche hat den Taycan umfangreich überarbeitet und in vielen Disziplinen verbessert. Die Batterie wird größer und kann schneller Laden. Alex Bloch fährt den Basis Taycan mit großer Batterie im E-Auto-Supertest und kommt aus dem Grinsen nicht mehr raus. Wie die Chancen stehen, dass der Taycan auf die Pole Position der Elektroautos fährt, seht ihr im Video.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der MG4 Electric im E-Auto Supertest
programme.desc: Der MG4 schwimmt auf der Erfolgswelle! Der Überflieger befindet sich unter den Top 5 der meistverkauften Elektroautos in Deutschland. Was der chinesischen Kompaktstromer im Vergleich zum Opel Astra Electric und dem VW ID.3 drauf hat, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Una nuova razza di squali famelici e aggressivi emerge dai ghiacci di una stazione di ricerca in Antartide, divorando tutti coloro che incontrano sul loro percorso. Per i sopravvissuti della stazione, che sta sprofondando nelle acque gelide, inizierà una lotta per la vita.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Apocalypse Earth - Apocalisse Sulla Terra
programme.desc: In seguito a un'invasione aliena, un gruppo di umani disperati fuggono dalla Terra e arrivano in un pianeta lontano. I rifugiati si ritroveranno ben presto a dover combattere per la propria sopravvivenza contro feroci e ostili creature.

programme.title: Absolon: Virus Mortale
programme.desc: Un virus ha infettato l'intera umanità e l'Absolon è un farmaco indispensabile per sopravvivere. Un agente di polizia inizia a indagare sull'omicidio di uno scienziato che stava lavorando a un antidoto contro il virus, arrivando a scoprire una cospirazione. Da quel momento diviene il bersaglio della società che monopolizza l'Absolon.

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: Planet Of The Sharks
programme.desc: In un futuro non troppo lontano, lo scioglimento dei ghiacciai ha coperto d'acqua il 98% del pianeta. In questo scenario, gli squali hanno preso il sopravvento guidati da un esemplare geneticamente mutato. I pochi umani sopravvissuti vivono nel terrore ma ben presto un piccolo gruppo di disperati tenterà tutto il possibile per rendere le acque nuovamente sicure.

programme.title: Empire Of The Sharks
programme.desc: Adrenalinico sci-fi scritto e diretto da Mark Atkins (Jurassic School) e sequel di Planet of the Sharks. In un futuro dove il 98% della superficie terrestre è sott’acqua, uno spietato signore della guerra governa grazie al suo esercito di super squali. Solo una ragazza con il potere psichico di comunicare con gli squali tenterà di opporsi, per sconfiggere il tiranno e liberare la sua gente.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: Cyber squali volanti cavalcati da supersoldati mutanti nazisti, attaccano un aereo di linea con l'intento di uccidere i passeggeri. Che la guerra abbia inizio!

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Una nuova razza di squali famelici e aggressivi emerge dai ghiacci di una stazione di ricerca in Antartide, divorando tutti coloro che incontrano sul loro percorso. Per i sopravvissuti della stazione, che sta sprofondando nelle acque gelide, inizierà una lotta per la vita.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Apocalypse Earth - Apocalisse Sulla Terra
programme.desc: In seguito a un'invasione aliena, un gruppo di umani disperati fuggono dalla Terra e arrivano in un pianeta lontano. I rifugiati si ritroveranno ben presto a dover combattere per la propria sopravvivenza contro feroci e ostili creature.

programme.title: The Recall - L'invasione
programme.desc: Charlie (RJ Mitte) si unisce ai suoi amici durante un weekend, in una cabina sul lago. Quella notte, un raggio di luce ultraterrena spunta giù dal cielo e rapisce gran parte del gruppo, portandolo sulla nave madre. I due superstiti, Charlie e Annie, devono fare affidamento su un eccentrico e misterioso cacciatore locale (Wesley Snipes), che sembra avere già esperienze dell'attacco.

programme.title: Ice 2020 - Parte 1
programme.desc: E ‘il 2020. I risultati di uno scienziato ambientale, il Professor Thom Archer suggeriscono che Halo, l’impresa di perforazione della società energetica sul ghiacciaio della Groenlandia ne stanno causando lo scioglimento. Gli avvertimenti di Archer vengono ignorati, così si dirige verso l’Artico per trovare prove inconfutabili. Al suo arrivo, si rende conto che l’umanità è in pericolo immediato, e corre a casa per salvare la sua famiglia. Il ghiacciaio collassa, con conseguenze devastanti...

programme.title: Airplane Vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Brace For Impact - Indagine Ad Alta Quota
programme.desc: Tensione alle stelle in questo thriller che vede l'esperta di disastri aerei Sofia coinvolta in un'indagine per far chiarezza sulle reali cause di un tragico incidente in cui ha perso la vita il fratello. Il suo desiderio di giustizia la porterà a infrangere le regole del servizio di intelligence e a scoprire un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Una tempesta solare spazza via il sistema di controllo del traffico aereo. I passeggeri dell'Air Force One e quelli di un jet di linea si ritrovano in rotta di collisione nei cieli sopra il Midwest.

programme.title: RAZOR: Coral Babies and Seagrass
programme.desc: In part-1 of the the show, The race to save the world's coral is on. These vital organisms are being devastated by mass bleaching events caused by climate change. At current rates, 99% could perish in marine heatwaves by the 2030s. To help ensure their survival, scientists are urgently working to reproduce coral species and restore reefs. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi visits the landlocked University of Derby—75 miles from the sea—where Dr Michael Sweet and his team are pioneering coral breeding techniques. By replicating reef conditions and even mimicking lunar cycles, they've successfully induced coral spawning—an event rarely seen by humans. In Part-2, Seagrass is the only flowering plant that grows in the sea providing an important habitat for many species. In the last century, it has seen a massive decline worldwide for a number of reasons. Project Seagrasses is a ￡400,000 restoration project, led by a team of scientists from Swansea University, backed the WWF and Sky Ocean Rescue.

programme.title: RAZOR: Ancient Wheat
programme.desc: We've been growing wheat for 10,000 years. Now most ancient wheat varieties have been displaced by modern kinds, which were bred to have higher yields and feed more people. But modern wheat is beset with problems - from diseases to the environmental impact of industrial farming. Now, a collaboration between British and Chinese scientists is exploring how to use the genes of ancient wheat to treat modern issues. RAZOR visits the John Innes Centre in Norwich, home to the Watkins collection, a repository of ancient wheat grains that was established by pioneering botanist Arthur E Watkins a century ago. Dr. Simon Griffiths explains how researchers have found traits like salt resistance and slug resistance in the genes of ancient wheat. We also speak to Professor Shifeng Cheng, a senior scientist at the Agricultural Genomics Institute in Shenzhen, whose team sequenced the DNA of all 827 remaining bread wheat varieties in the Watkins collection.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Beyond the screen: how “film ” tourism and AI redefine moviegoer experience
programme.desc: As the Beijing International Film Festival takes over the city, films are no longer just something we watch in cinemas. They’re connecting tourism, retail, entertainment, and even cutting-edge tech. What does this “film plus” experience look like for audiences today? And as AI reshapes the film industry, what opportunities and challenges lie ahead? Host Xu Yawen spoke with Li Lun, assistant professor of economics at Peking University; Geng Ling, film producer and CEO of China Film Assist Company; and Teng Jimeng, associate professor of American studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University, to delve into these questions.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: Innovating at Scale: Behind the Scenes of AMNC26
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Economic Forum's (WEF) Annual Meeting of the New Champions, or known as the "Summer Davos" in Dalian, CGTN’s Michael Wang speaks with three key WEF organizers to explore what it takes to scale innovation in a rapidly changing world. This special discussion offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at how the WEF brings together innovators, businesses and policymakers to turn ideas into real-world change.

programme.title: The World Cup Economy
programme.desc: As the FIFA World Cup kicks off, the spotlight is not only on the field, but also on the massive economic opportunities unfolding beyond the stadiums. From tourism to business partnerships, the world's top sporting event is bringing people, markets and ideas closer together. But what does it take to turn global exposure into long-term growth? And what are the new trends shaping sports marketing? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the business opportunities behind "the beautiful game."

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

Project Seagrasses is a ￡400,000 restoration project, led by a team of scientists from Swansea University, backed the WWF and Sky Ocean Rescue.

programme.title: RAZOR: Ancient Wheat
programme.desc: We've been growing wheat for 10,000 years. Now most ancient wheat varieties have been displaced by modern kinds, which were bred to have higher yields and feed more people. But modern wheat is beset with problems - from diseases to the environmental impact of industrial farming. Now, a collaboration between British and Chinese scientists is exploring how to use the genes of ancient wheat to treat modern issues. RAZOR visits the John Innes Centre in Norwich, home to the Watkins collection, a repository of ancient wheat grains that was established by pioneering botanist Arthur E Watkins a century ago. Dr. Simon Griffiths explains how researchers have found traits like salt resistance and slug resistance in the genes of ancient wheat. We also speak to Professor Shifeng Cheng, a senior scientist at the Agricultural Genomics Institute in Shenzhen, whose team sequenced the DNA of all 827 remaining bread wheat varieties in the Watkins collection.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Beyond the screen: how “film ” tourism and AI redefine moviegoer experience
programme.desc: As the Beijing International Film Festival takes over the city, films are no longer just something we watch in cinemas. They’re connecting tourism, retail, entertainment, and even cutting-edge tech. What does this “film plus” experience look like for audiences today? And as AI reshapes the film industry, what opportunities and challenges lie ahead? Host Xu Yawen spoke with Li Lun, assistant professor of economics at Peking University; Geng Ling, film producer and CEO of China Film Assist Company; and Teng Jimeng, associate professor of American studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University, to delve into these questions.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: Innovating at Scale: Behind the Scenes of AMNC26
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Economic Forum's (WEF) Annual Meeting of the New Champions, or known as the "Summer Davos" in Dalian, CGTN’s Michael Wang speaks with three key WEF organizers to explore what it takes to scale innovation in a rapidly changing world. This special discussion offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at how the WEF brings together innovators, businesses and policymakers to turn ideas into real-world change.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO

But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition. From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Chengdu Lacquerware Art
programme.desc: Chengdu lacquerware is unique, thanks to its “three carvings and one engraving” technique. Along with its bold decorative style, this has made it a gem of Chinese lacquer art. Chengdu lacquerware also emphasizes the use of vibrant colors. Pieces are brought to beautiful life by bright red, vivid yellow, emerald green, and other striking hues.

programme.title: A talk with Li Kehua: Translating Chinese heritage through dance
programme.desc: In an era where dance converges with digital art and ancient myths find new life through motion capture, Li Kehua stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation. In this interview, she reflected on cross-cultural collaborations, the thrill of uncovering traditional crafts, and why she views herself not as a star, but as a humble stepping stone – helping audiences cross into a new world.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China : Shanghai
programme.desc: Balancing delicately on an alluvial plain and the Yangtze estuary of China’s east coast, much of Shanghai-literally meaning “on the sea”-sits at an average sea-level elevation of about 4 meters. Bisecting the city is the Huangpu River, dividing it into Puxi (west bank) and Pudong (east bank), where you’ll find its famous international airport. Join us as on an aerial cruise as we journey upstream towards one of the world’s most recognizable skylines.

programme.title: A talk with Li Kehua: Translating Chinese heritage through dance
programme.desc: In an era where dance converges with digital art and ancient myths find new life through motion capture, Li Kehua stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation. In this interview, she reflected on cross-cultural collaborations, the thrill of uncovering traditional crafts, and why she views herself not as a star, but as a humble stepping stone – helping audiences cross into a new world.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: Welcome to Chongqing, China's largest city. Located in the country's southwest, it straddles two mighty rivers and is famed for its extraordinary skyline, with high-rises mushrooming out of the hills and vertigo-inducing bridges.But Tianran He and Angela Fu are here for the food: From xiaomian noodles and Jianghu cuisine to the city's most famous dish: Chongqing hotpot, our hosts take on the spicy, numbing and scintillating aromas of Chongqing cuisine. We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: Ancient melodies, modern vibes: Sang Tian's music
programme.desc: Chinese traditional music is often seen as something rooted in the past. But singer-songwriter Sang Tian is finding new ways for it to live in the present. He calls himself a "translator," fine-tuning ancient melodies into a modern musical language.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Untapped: Changsha
programme.desc: The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO "Creative City". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. The soul of a city is in its people, and this episode focuses on the women of Changsha who are helping to innovate, change and further develop this city they call home.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture...

programme.title: Ancient melodies, modern vibes: Sang Tian's music
programme.desc: Chinese traditional music is often seen as something rooted in the past. But singer-songwriter Sang Tian is finding new ways for it to live in the present. He calls himself a "translator," fine-tuning ancient melodies into a modern musical language.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Cacería de Asesinos
programme.desc: Consumido por el dolor y la rabia por el asesinato de su hijo, decide emprender una búsqueda implacable de justicia por su cuenta, enfrentándose a los responsables de la tragedia.

programme.title: Cuatro de Copas
programme.desc: Tres amigos, que después de una noche de alcohol no recuerdan nada de la noche anterior.

programme.title: Nubes de Cartón
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Miguel es un sin hogar, aislado de la sociedad.

programme.title: La travesía
programme.desc: Cinco migrantes centroamericanos enfrentan las más duras pruebas para alcanzar el sueño americano.

programme.title: Cobardes
programme.desc: Gaby, un pelirrojo de 14 ańos en Barcelona, sufre constantes robos y palizas a manos de Guille y su despiadada pandilla, quienes lo apodan "Zanahoria". Incapaz de compartir su sufrimiento con sus padres, siempre ocupados con sus trabajos, Gaby se encierra en sí mismo mientras el bullying se intensifica. La madre de Guille encuentra un video violento en el móvil de su hijo y, aunque lo borra, Guille niega todo y se presenta como víctima ante el psicólogo escolar. La historia da un giro inesperado cuando el dueńo de la pizzería favorita de Gaby, un mafioso secreto, podría tener una pista que cambiará radicalmente las cosas. La situación se complica aún más cuando los padres de los involucrados, absortos en sus propios problemas, no logran percibir la magnitud del sufrimiento de Gaby, dejándolo cada vez más aislado y vulnerable.

programme.title: La Boleta
programme.desc: La vida de Pablo es una serie de eventos desafortunados. Después de un intento de suicidio fallido, tiene un sueño con números ganadores de lotería. Sin embargo, cuando va a comprar un billete, es asaltado. Sin dejarse desanimar, Pablo cree que los números aún serán ganadores y persigue a los ladrones por un barrio pobre.

programme.title: La Buena Nueva
programme.desc: Miguel es nombrado sacerdote de una parroquia en un pueblo socialista durante la sublevación de 1936. Este joven párroco terminará por enfrentarse a la jerarquía eclesiástica y al ejercito español para defender a los represaliados durante la guerra civil española.

programme.title: Flor de Azúcar
programme.desc: Un joven campesino se ve obligado a huir después de matar involuntariamente a un guardia abusivo. Después de pasar un año entero escondido en una remota isla de pesca, decide regresar a su campo y reunirse con su esposa e hijas.

programme.title: Cobardes
programme.desc: Gaby, un pelirrojo de 14 ańos en Barcelona, sufre constantes robos y palizas a manos de Guille y su despiadada pandilla, quienes lo apodan "Zanahoria". Incapaz de compartir su sufrimiento con sus padres, siempre ocupados con sus trabajos, Gaby se encierra en sí mismo mientras el bullying se intensifica. La madre de Guille encuentra un video violento en el móvil de su hijo y, aunque lo borra, Guille niega todo y se presenta como víctima ante el psicólogo escolar. La historia da un giro inesperado cuando el dueńo de la pizzería favorita de Gaby, un mafioso secreto, podría tener una pista que cambiará radicalmente las cosas. La situación se complica aún más cuando los padres de los involucrados, absortos en sus propios problemas, no logran percibir la magnitud del sufrimiento de Gaby, dejándolo cada vez más aislado y vulnerable.

programme.title: Las Plantas
programme.desc: Florencia es una chica de 17 años que debe hacerse cargo de su hermano, que se encuentra en estado vegetativo. Tratando de sobrevivir sola y con problemas financieros, Florencia comenzará a quedar con desconocidos por internet y acabará obsesionándose con un cómic llamado -Las Plantas-, que trata de la invasión de unos espiritus vegetales en los cuerpos humanos cuando sale la luna llena.

programme.title: La Boleta
programme.desc: La vida de Pablo es una serie de eventos desafortunados. Después de un intento de suicidio fallido, tiene un sueño con números ganadores de lotería. Sin embargo, cuando va a comprar un billete, es asaltado. Sin dejarse desanimar, Pablo cree que los números aún serán ganadores y persigue a los ladrones por un barrio pobre.

programme.title: 12 Catástrofes
programme.desc: El día que Jacey cumple 18 años empiezan a suceder cosas extrañas: el agua se vuelve roja, tornados aparecen de la nada y punzantes lanzas de hielo caen del cielo. Pronto se da cuenta que ella es la única que tiene el poder de detener la fatalidad inminente. Usando un antiguo libro de profecías mayas y con la ayuda de su padre, Jacey buscará la manera de frenar los doce desastres que han activado la cuenta atrás para el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Experimento Filadelfia
programme.desc: El intento por recrear un antiguo experimento secreto del gobierno fracasa y provoca un agujero espaciotemporal que hace que reaparezca el USS Eldridge, un acorazado de la Segunda Guerra Mundial que desapareció hace más de 70 años. Solo el único superviviente de la nave, acompañado por su nieta, una brillante científica, podrá detener la embarcación antes de que destroce el planeta.

programme.title: Bermuda Tentacles
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One se hunde en el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía a su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero al rescatar al presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: Planet Dune V2
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Es el Blitz de Londres en 1940. Un anciano y enfermo Dr. John Watson cuenta a su enfermera la historia de su investigación más compleja con Sherlock Holmes, que ambos juraron que nunca se contaría al público ni se adaptaría a una de las famosas historias de Watson.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: El Cobrador 2
programme.desc: Two debt collectors are plunged into an extremely dangerous situation, pursuing various criminals while evading a vengeful enemy.

programme.title: Arachnid
programme.desc: Una expedición científica que investiga el brote de una epidemia vírica desconocida en una isla del sur del Pacífico se enfrenta a una araña alienígena gigante en la jungla.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: Asalto sin límite
programme.desc: Es una vida sucia y rentable de crimen para los ladrones de coches conocidos como «choppers». Se necesita velocidad, valor y saber hacer, pero si a eso le añadimos un asesinato y un policía encubierto, la cosa puede ponerse explosiva.

programme.title: Blackjack
programme.desc: Dolph Lundgren interpreta a Jack Devlin, un U.S Marshal que protege a clientes de alto perfil cuando se trata de una cuestión de seguridad.

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.title: El valle Oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: Opération Cobra
programme.desc: Un agent d'Interpol se rend en Inde pour retrouver le terroriste qui a tué son partenaire.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: Un patron du crime envoie son meilleur homme pour tuer un prisonnier. Il se trompe d'homme et en paie le prix. 6 mois plus tard, il est de nouveau sur pied. Son ex-patron se fait maintenant évincer par Ice Man, qui est responsable de l'affaire de la "mauvaise personne".

programme.title: King Rising 3
programme.desc: Dominic Purcell se transforme d’un tueur à gages moderne en guerrier médiéval dans cette aventure pleine d’action inspirée de la série de jeux vidéo Dungeon Siege. Découvrez des effets spéciaux époustouflants qui donnent vie à une action ininterrompue. Un tueur à gages est transporté au Moyen Âge, où il doit affronter une armée gigantesque – et un dragon cracheur de feu – dans une bataille acharnée pour survivre !

programme.title: Complot Terroriste
programme.desc: "Sebastian Dellacourt, assassin gouvernemental redoutable, rate une mission et finit en prison. Sa seule chance d’en sortir : accepter un dernier contrat. Il doit infiltrer une milice dangereuse dirigée par Arno Taylor, un idéaliste délirant déterminé à renverser le gouvernement américain."

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Assaut sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim est un New-Yorkais ordinaire menant une vie paisible avec un emploi bien rémunéré et une famille aimante. Soudain, tout bascule lorsque l’économie s’effondre, faisant perdre à Jim tout ce qu’il avait. Rempli de colère et de rage, Jim craque et va jusqu’à l’extrême pour se venger de la vie qu’on lui a arrachée.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: Yeti : Terreur en Montagne
programme.desc: Des amis partent à l'aventure dans la neige et tombent nez à nez avec une créature mortelle.

programme.title: Age of the Dragons
programme.desc: Le roman classique Moby Dick de Herman Melville est recréé dans un monde où le capitaine Achab et son équipage sont à la recherche d'un grand dragon blanc.

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Zombeavers
programme.desc: Un groupe d’adolescents en vacances au bord d’une rivière se retrouve menacé par une horde de castors zombies. Le weekend de débauche va rapidement tourner à la catastrophe pour les jeunes. Pour rester en vie, ils vont devoir se confronter aux castors zombies qui les attaquent dans leurs propres cabines...

programme.title: La saison des Requins
programme.desc: Trois kayakistes luttent pour leur vie lorsqu'un grand requin blanc les piège sur une petite île en train de sombrer.

programme.title: Chroniques de mutants
programme.desc: À la fin de l'ère glaciaire, La Machine est venue de l'espace pour transformer les hommes en mutants. Cependant, un héros a vaincu cet engin et un grand sceau a été apposé sur La Machine. En 2707, le monde épuisé est gouverné par quatre corporations : Mishima, Bauhaus, Capitol et Imperial, qui sont en état de guerre permanent

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Robin, Frecce, Fagioli E Karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: Giuseppe Venduto Dai Fratelli
programme.desc: Tradito dai fratelli e venduto come schiavo, Giuseppe affronta prove durissime in Egitto fino a diventare uomo di fiducia del faraone.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: Un forajido intenta acabar con su descendencia eliminando a su malvada línea consanguínea.

programme.title: Ercole Contro I Tiranni Di Babilonia
programme.desc: Tra complotti e battaglie spettacolari, Ercole sfida i tiranni di Babilonia per salvare il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Sonora
programme.desc: En 1931 en México, bajo la presión del gobierno de Sonora, un grupo de personas se ven obligadas a viajar a Mexicalli, donde se enfrentan al racismo y a otros peligros en el desierto

programme.title: Maciste Nella Terra Dei Ciclopi
programme.desc: Tra mostri, terre misteriose e battaglie leggendarie, Maciste affronta i ciclopi per salvare un popolo minacciato

programme.title: Banda de rebeldes
programme.desc: Un grupo de soldados confederados utiliza sus habilidades únicas para viajar tras las líneas enemigas y llevar a cabo misiones mortales que causan estragos en el ejército de la Unión.

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Una pistola para cien cruces
programme.desc: Un irlandés es asesinado en el salvaje Oeste. Su hijo Jimmy sale en busca de los asesinos de su padre, pero pronto cae en una emboscada de dos salteadores de caminos y es asesinado también. Django (o Sartana, según la versión de la película) lo encuentra y lee la carta que Jimmy había recibido de su hermana Jessica Dublin contándole el asesinato de su padre.

programme.title: L'assedio Di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all’avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: Érase una vez en Tombstone
programme.desc: Esta película ofrece todos los grandes personajes que cabría esperar en una película sobre Tombstone. Los hermanos Earp, los hermanos Clanton, Doc Holliday, Johnny Ringo, etc. y grandes tiroteos. Lo que la película ofrece es una multitud de piezas del rompecabezas que completan la historia, no sólo acerca de por qué ocurrió el tiroteo, sino la historia real de lo que condujo a ella y lo que siguió.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: 7 Winchester per un Massacro
programme.desc: Un pistolero se une a una banda de guerrilleros confederados para encontrar un alijo de oro confederado desaparecido.

programme.title: Il Vecchio Testamento
programme.desc: Dalla creazione ai grandi profeti, episodi biblici prendono vita tra miracoli, prove e destini che segnano la storia dell’umanità.

programme.title: Eminence Hills
programme.desc: Un rastro de venganza conduce a un notorio asesino y a un agente de la ley a un pueblo de fanáticos. Correrá la sangre.

programme.title: Barabba
programme.desc: Liberato al posto di Gesù, il brigante Barabba vive tormentato dal dubbio su chi fosse davvero l’uomo condannato alla croce.

programme.title: Yellow Rock
programme.desc: Cinco hombres cabalgan hacia el inquietante pueblo de Yellow Rock, con la esperanza de rescatar a un familiar y a su hijo perdido.

programme.title: SIN NOMBRE Y DINAMITA
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite comienza cuando conocemos a la pareja de cazarrecompensas formada por No Name (Northup) y Dynamite Davenport (Ting), que siguen su propio camino para cobrar las recompensas, pero se ayudan mutuamente cuando se trata de las recompensas más difíciles.

programme.title: Giulio Cesare
programme.desc: Abile politico, fine scrittore, valoroso soldato, ma anche semplice uomo. Tutta la vita di Giulio Cesare, dalle grandi gesta, all'amore per Cleopatra, fino al tragico assassinio. Diecimila comparse, seicento cavalli, fedeli ricostruzioni storiche: l'incredibile vita di uno degli uomini più importanti della storia. Con Jeremy Sisto, Richard Harris, Christopher Walken e Valeria Golino.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Un hombre inculpado de asesinato escapa de la cárcel y se dirige al Oeste, donde se une a una banda en la que está implicado el verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Los Cartwright acuden en ayuda de un mozo de cuadra chino-americano acusado de asesinato. Enfrente tienen a un manipulador candidato a alcalde que quiere que todos los «extranjeros» abandonen Virginia City.

programme.title: Davide E Golia
programme.desc: Con Orson Welles, Davide affronta Golia nella sfida che segna il destino di Israele

programme.title: La Balada de Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Un gángster supuestamente muerto quiere implicar a un hombre completamente inocente para que pague por sus crímenes y así poder dar esquinazo a sus vengadores y perseguidores.

programme.title: La Promesa del Pistolero
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su mujer y su hijo a manos de un delincuente fugado, el sheriff Matt Austin se dispone a capturarlo, pero descubre que ha sido contratado por un codicioso barón de la tierra que pretende arrebatarle las tierras a una viuda y su hijo.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: Sandokan Contro Il Leopardo Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: El inspector Leduque llega de Nueva Orleans a Virginia City para detener a Ben Cartwright por un asesinato cometido hace 20 años. Cuando Ben declara públicamente que se retira de la carrera por la gobernación, la gente del pueblo se molesta no sólo por esto, sino que Little Joe también ha sido acusado de matar a tiros a sangre fría al ayudante de Leduque.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Les couleurs du désert
programme.desc: Deux hommes trouvent un bébé abandonné et se disputent la propriété de l'enfant, ce qui entraîne une rivalité à vie.

programme.title: Billy va te plomber
programme.desc: Quatre hors-la-loi de l'Ouest effectuent un braquage de banque dans la ville de la ruée vers l'or, Bath Water. Alors que le groupe se lance à la poursuite, les choses empirent, car les bandits se rendent compte qu'ils ont été doublés.

programme.title: Trinita va tout casser
programme.desc: Les victimes de Honey, le chef oppressif de la ville, reçoivent l'aide d'une alliance inhabituelle entre des hommes armés et des artistes de cirque.

programme.title: Ta tombe est prête Sartana !
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys se font voler leur or dans les montagnes rocheuses et décident de se défendre en affrontant les bandits.

programme.title: Le justicier de Dieu
programme.desc: Un ancien tireur devenu prêtre cherche à se venger de trois bandits qui se font passer pour des citoyens respectueux de la loi.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: Le temps des vautours
programme.desc: Engagé par un propriétaire terrien mexicain pour sauver sa fille des mains d'un bandit, un chasseur de primes décide finalement de se joindre au malfaiteur pour un braquage afin d'obtenir une meilleure récompense, ce qui aboutit à une trahison tragique.

programme.title: Une longue file de croix
programme.desc: Django et Sartana sont des chasseurs de primes qui éliminent des bandits dans une petite ville de l'Ouest. Un méchant propriétaire foncier fait entrer clandestinement des immigrants clandestins et les hommes qui travaillent pour lui payent la tête à un prix exorbitant. Il est donc logique que Django et Sartana passent un appel d'ici peu.

programme.title: No Name & Dynamite
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite commence lorsque nous rencontrons le partenariat de chasse aux primes entre No Name (Northup) et Dynamite Davenport (Ting), qui font leur propre chemin pour collecter les primes, mais s'entraident lorsqu'il s'agit des primes les plus difficiles.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: La mort était au rendez-vous
programme.desc: Un jeune tireur forme une alliance ténue avec un ancien hors-la-loi vieillissant pour traquer et éliminer les bandits qui ont tué sa famille, jusqu'à la fin surprenante.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

Es tiempo de ver el mover de Dios en tu vida y en tu familia!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: In this episode, host Kleber travels to Foshan in southern China’s Guangdong Province, to explore the culture of Wing Chun kung fu. There he’ll meet two Wing Chun masters: Guo Weizhan, his first instructor in China, and Xian Zhiming, an expert in the unique principles of Snake-Style Wing Chun.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In 2022, a video game inspired by Pak Mei kung fu became an online sensation. Continuing his exploration of Foshan, host Kleber meets with a true master of Pak Mei to learn more of the history of martial arts, as well as its connections to food, family and community.

programme.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.1
programme.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.
